recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining active-source gap for FHIR-29330 without reverting later accepted Library wording or adding redundant prose.
issue_request: FHIR-29330 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification after reporting that the Library Description and Constraints wording was too restrictive for a resource used beyond quality improvement. The accepted resolution was to describe Library as a general-purpose container for knowledge asset definitions and collections.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify commit 49eb38dc18485be64d742a4c7385e1d1b8c60001 and HL7/fhir#2834. That commit broadened source/library/library-introduction.xml, but it did not update source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml, where the root short description still said "Represents a library of quality improvement components".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active library=Library resource entry, so the edited StructureDefinition is in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-50408 and commit 54d2928ff30cd501b1fabd000ed53cca6524852c changed the accepted Library wording from knowledge assets to knowledge artifacts in the description, definition, and introduction. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence for FHIR-29330.
reconciliation: Changed only source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml root short to "Represents a library of knowledge artifacts". The longer description, root definition, and introduction were left unchanged because they already convey the broader general-purpose scope and reflect the later FHIR-50408 terminology refinement.
source_changes: source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml: changed the Library root <short> from "Represents a library of quality improvement components" to "Represents a library of knowledge artifacts".

related_jiras.note: Applied later Library clarification that changed the accepted wording from knowledge assets to knowledge artifacts and supported narrowing this reconciliation to the stale root short description.
